title: Child-safety gate reads only typed words; picture and clip verdicts cached per file
description: Fabio 2026-10-16: the gate keyword-matches EVERY string param (Flow template text, describer prose, enhancer output), so app-written words refuse innocent runs (MPI-1086: Input_Mannequin_Prompt 'no clothes', then the describer's 'nude lipstick' refused Makeup on a child sheet). Redesign: (1) the gate reads only words a person typed (prompt box incl. accepted Enhancer output, Flow free-text fields, an agent's prompt), carried on the config as userWords set at the edges; Flow template text and describer prose never read; a test asserts no Flow template asks for nudity. (2) Every picture used as an input gets its age verdict asked once, on first use, cached per FILE (hash) with the question version; an edit of a picture marked under 18 inherits it; imports cost nothing until used. Videos: first frame plus a few more frames (e.g. middle, last), same cache. (3) A reference picture whose CONTENT is applied to someone (Clothes) gets one fixed YES/NO question (underwear, lingerie or revealing swimwear?) instead of keyword-reading describer prose, cached the same way. Blocks MPI-1086 Makeup eye tests.
